drivers: Simple Latin-square permutation of three bound shape/fill combinations; the missing cell is the one combination absent from row 3 and column 3
Count (3) and rotation are constant across all cells, so no extra rules to track
Distractors recombine shape and fill in ways never seen in the grid (e.g., solid pentagons, empty arrows), so verifying against any grid cell eliminates them
Generous 75-second limit for a low working-memory-load item
